review_summary.college_name: Delhi Technical Campus, Haryana Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and facilities with supportive faculty and decent placements.

content.Placements: 50 to 60 percent students get placed annually, with top recruiters like TCS, Wipro, HCL and Samsung. The highest package is 14 LPA to 15 LPA and the lowest is 3 LPA. Roles offered such as software developer, web developer, data analyst, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides high speed campus wide Wi Fi with dedicated access points in department buildings. It has well equipped computer labs with modern systems, updated software and AC environment for practical sessions. It has smart classrooms with projectors sound systems and comfortable seating. Department specific section in the central library with textbooks, reference books, journals, etc. There are separate hostels for boys and girls furnished rooms with bed, table, chair, etc. It provides balanced menu with vegetarian and non-vegetarian options, weekly special meals and clean cooking environment. Facilities for cricket, football, basketball, badminton, other indoor games, etc., are available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the college.

content.Placements: The placement services are good enough. The average package offered is about 4-4.5 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Infosys, Wipro, etc. About 70% of students got internships in these companies. The internship cell is very much active when needed.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi facilities are available on the college campus. The library is full-fledged. Rooms are fully ventilated. Sports are too good. The infrastructure is too good. Labs are hygienic and well maintained. The canteen and mess food are also hygienic and within cost.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the facilities.

content.Placements: At the end of the sixth semester, we got placement services. There is no recruitment. Only 5% to 10% of students got internships from our course. The average salary package offered is not that great. The college needs to work on its placement services.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. Every facility is provided to us. Labs are clean and hygienic. Classrooms are hygienic. The canteen area is well maintained. A Wi-Fi facility is provided to all students on the college campus, and sports are good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: It is an average college with good infrastructure.

content.Placements: The highest salary package offered in our college was 10 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered was 1.6 LPA. The average salary package offered was 4.5 LPA. Last year an average number of students were placed from our course, and their salary packages were also not good. The top recruiting company here was Byju's.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is really good. Our college is very clean and tidy, and the campus is huge as well. Moreover, all the labs and facilities are available in our college. Hostel facilities are bad, and the canteen is also not available. Moreover, there are no nearby shops.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Our college infrastructure and gardens are good, and the campus area is huge.

content.Placements: The majority of the recruiter come only for BBA and MBA. The highest salary package offered till now is 10 LPA by Byju's. Our college doesn't offer internships and does not help to get them. All the students find an internship in the corporate on their own outside.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good, and labs are good. The library is good, but it doesn't have updated books. The cafeteria is closed now. Wi-Fi speed is not good, and there is an electrical problem. Water supply breaks after 2:00 pm. Our college also has network problems.

content.Placements: One way to describe Indian School of Science and Management (ISSM) is its placement cell. Students can opt these programs to pursue their career in Teaching & Education, IT & Software, Design, Beauty & Fitness, Humanities & Social Sciences, Science, Mass Communication & Media, Accounting & Commerce, Banking, Finance & Insurance, Business & Management Studies, Arts ( Fine / Visual / Performing ), Animation, Medicine & Health Sciences. Institute has trained & experienced faculty who deliver these programs. Kanya Maha Vidyalaya has a review rating of 4.4 on the basis of reviews by students. In addition to this, it has been rated 4.4 on campuslife, 4.1 on placements, 4.5 on faculty and 4.3 on Infrastructure.

review_summary.college_name: Kanya Maha Vidyalaya Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Psychology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: My best part of my life started in college.

content.Placements: In the M.A. Psychology course at KMV, placements depend a lot on individual skills and interest areas. While core psychology roles may not provide mass placements like technical fields. Many students did get opportunities in counseling, teaching, or internships at mental health centers. A few also prepared for competitive exams or went for higher studies like M.Phil or Ph.D. Internships were usually available in hospitals, NGOs, or with psychologists, which helped in building practical knowledge.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of KMV was quite good. Classrooms were well-organized and had a calm atmosphere for studying. Campus had strong Wi-Fi connectivity. The library was peaceful with a wide collection of psychology books and research materials. The environment was clean and disciplined. The mess food was vegetarian but hygienic and better than many other colleges. College also provided a safe and comfortable space for female students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the college is good and affordable.

content.Placements: I did not know much about placement or internships. Maybe it will be good. The college should be supportive of students and teachers should also guide them. I did not know much about it. I have very little knowledge about placements and internships.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the biotech department is very good. There are well-maintained labs and the equipment is also good enough. The classroom and library are well decorated and maintained. Overall, we can say it is very valuable and good. All other facilities are provided on campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Infrastructure and facilities are fine.

content.Placements: Many companies like byju, vistara, radisson visit campus every year and students get placed with handsome salary. The highest package offered is 5 Lacs Per annum by the company byju in the biotechnology department. Students mainly opt for higher education.
content.Infrastructure: Modern labs with many equipments like spectrophotometer, laminar air flow, autoclave, centrifuge is present in the department. A departmental library continuing many reference and costly books and smart classrooms with projector are present in the campus.

individual_reviews.title: Best autonomous heritage .

content.Placements: There is the presence of placement cell in the college from where all the students get their placements at the end of the semester, according to their performance. content.Infrastructure: Our department provides a lot of knowledge about the theoretical as well as practical. They provide internship programs which are compulsory for the students. In the hostel, there is hygienic food as well as washrooms to use. There is home like environment in the college.

individual_reviews.title: KMV is the best with good infrastructure and good faculty.

hostel.description:
Founded in I886, KMV boarding house, ‘Kanya Ashram’, as it was popularly called, is situated within the precincts of the college. The hostel building consists of four hostel wings- Savitri Bhawan, Rai Bahadur Badri Das Hostel, Saraswati Bhawan and New Hostel. Located in lush green and eco-friendly surroundings, the hostel has a provision of accommodation for about 800 girl students.
Furnished with state-of-the-art infrastructure, the Institution provides all modern amenities to the boarders such as water coolers, solar system, T.V, LCD Projector, newspapers. Spacious and airy rooms are fitted with a ceiling fan and a tube light each. In order to ensure pure, uncontaminated and uninterrupted water supply, filters and purifiers have been installed.

library.description: Fully digitized three storey Library with more than 100000 Books, Magazines and Journals.

review_summary.college_name: S D College of Management Studies (SDCMS) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Overall, SDC is a good college for those who want to get quality education.

content.Placements: Placements provided by our SDC College are very good. Companies like Infosys, Wipro, Volvo, IDBM, Amazon, etc., offer placements. The college trains students for their interview. This college is represented for its quality and discipline.
content.Infrastructure: SDC College provides van facilities for free to every student. Classrooms are effective. Sports facilities are available. A canteen is available. The college provides good quality education with placements. It helps to involve in competitive activities, and it also has an NSS unit.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty. I should say that it is a good college to study.

content.Placements: Our college is very good. Studies in our college are also too good. The teachers are well qualified and educated. The discipline of our college is also adorable. Many companies also came every year in our college, and many students are placed in many companies from the college itself. So overall, it is a good college to study.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is also good. Sports facilities are provided, and Wi-Fi enabled campus library, and well-maintained medical facilities are there for any mishappening. The physical environment is also better, and there is greenery in our college for the good atmosphere.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: S D College of Management Studies, Muzaffarnagar.

content.Placements: I have heard from some of my friends that companies do not come here, and even if they come, they will come with very low packages. Also, the college will show a big poster showcasing the students who graduated from this college. Now I don't know whether this is true or false.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good, there are two buildings, one for the Master's and the other for the Bachelors. In a building, there are 3-4 Wi-Fi points, and there are many labs present in the building for every subject. In the library, some books are present while others are not. In this college, hostels are not available.

admission_overview.title: Kuppam Engineering College Admission Overview 2025
admission_overview.description: Kuppam Engineering College admission is entrance-based. Kuppam Engineering College offers several programmes at undergraduate and postgraduate levels in the fields of Engineering and Management. To get a seat in any of the offered courses, students are required to satisfy the admission criteria of the desired course. The college accepts several national and state-level entrance tests, such as AP EAMCET/ BIEAP/ AP POLYCET.

eligibility_selection.title: Kuppam Engineering College Eligibility & Selection 2025
eligibility_selection.description: Kuppam Engineering College course admission is made on the basis of preset admission criteria. Students looking to join the UG courses need to pass Class 12 or equivalent, whereas PG admissions require students to complete graduation from a recognised university. In addition to clearing the basic eligibility, students must also provide valid entrance exam scores. Find below the eligibility and selection criteria for popular Kuppam Engineering College courses:

admission_process.title: Kuppam Engineering College Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: The admission process for Kuppam Engineering College includes several steps from application to selection, followed by admission confirmation. Students can apply online for the desired programme by registering. Before applying, students must make sure that they fulfil the admission criteria as specified by the college. Eligible students can follow the steps explained below to complete theKuppam Engineering College admission process:
Step 1: Application Process

Interested students can apply online by visiting the official website of the college and filling out the application form. Students need to provide the required information and documents to complete the process.
Step 2: Selection Process

Students are mainly selected based on entrance exam scores. For admission to the BTech programme, the college accepts AP EAMCET. Admission to the MBA and MTech programme needs candidates to have AP ICET and GATE or AP PGECET, respectively.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation
Selected students need to pay theKuppam Engineering College admission feesof the college to secure their seats.

courses_data.name: Kuppam Engineering College BTech Admission 2025
courses_data.description: Kuppam Engineering College has a four-year BTech course in different engineering branches. It accepts students on the basis of AP EAMCET marks and Class 12 results with a minimum of 45% PCM. The course integrates theoretical concepts with practical work and exposure to industries.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for BTech at Kuppam Engineering College?
faqs.answer: Kuppam Engineering College demands students to secure Class 12 with a minimum of 45% marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics. Students belonging to the reserved category can also get admitted with 40%. Furthermore, students need to qualify Andhra Pradesh EAMCET for BTech admission.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is accepted for BTech admission at Kuppam Engineering College?
faqs.answer: AP EAMCET scores are accepted by Kuppam Engineering College for admission to BTech. Students need to apply and attend the state-authorised counselling. Admission is offered depending on rank, score, and availability of seats.

faqs.question: What specialisations are available under the BTech programme at Kuppam Engineering College?
faqs.answer: Kuppam Engineering College provides BTech specializations in Computer Science, Electronics & Communication, Electrical & Electronics, Mechanical, and Civil Engineering. All the programmes are AICTE-approved and are affiliated with JNTU Anantapur. The students are provided with hands-on training and placement assistance.

courses_data.name: After 10th Diploma Admissions 2026
Kuppam Engineering College MBA Admission 2025
courses_data.description: Kuppam Engineering College provides a two-year full-time MBA programme with business and management skills. Admission is available through graduation with 50% marks and an AP ICET valid score. The programme offers specialisations such as Finance, Marketing, and HR with placement assistance.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for MBA at Kuppam Engineering College?
faqs.answer: Kuppam Engineering College demands that the candidates possess a bachelor's degree with minimum 50% marks for MBA admission. Reserved category students can also apply with 45% marks. Moreover, passing Andhra Pradesh ICET is also mandatory for selection.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is accepted for MBA admission at Kuppam Engineering College?
faqs.answer: Kuppam Engineering College only accepts Andhra Pradesh ICET marks for MBA admission. Applicants are required to apply in Andhra Pradesh ICET counselling organized by the state authorities. Admission is done on a basis of exam rank and seat availability.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Machine Design - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: The college has good placements and infrastructure, with a good environment.

content.Placements: Placements were okay. Most companies were product-based, but bulk hiring happened only for service-based projects. The highest package was 32 LPA, the lowest package was 3 LPA, and the average package was 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies included Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, and TCS.
content.Infrastructure: College had a beautiful view with green trees and a garden. Environment was peaceful, but busy with students. Transport facilities were provided from the campus, or we could also go by public transport. Sports and cultural activities took place. Full security was provided for hostels as well as for the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: The college has good infrastructure and offers good placements.

content.Placements: Placements started in the 7th and 8th semesters. Our college placements were excellent. The salary package offered was 8 LPA to 10 LPA. Placement guidance was provided beforehand. Nowadays, no placements are coming to other colleges, but we were happy with our placements.
content.Infrastructure: The college atmosphere was excellent, with greenery, a beautiful campus, and a good environment. The infrastructure was excellent. Laboratories were well-equipped to perform activities.
content.Faculty: Faculty members were generally very positive. They were highly qualified, experienced, and helpful professors. Many holding PhDs, who taught in English and fostered good student interaction. They prepared students well for the industry through practical learning and support. Students improved their subject expertise, professionalism, and ability to learn effectively, though some reviews mentioned that faculty from North India taught only in English, which could be an advantage for communication skills. All the staff members were highly educated. They created a supportive environment and were always willing to help students, especially with career guidance. Their friendly and encouraging nature made the learning experience enjoyable for us.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: RK College is in rectangular shape with nice ventilation.

content.Placements: In our college, the percentage of students who passed 4 years is 60% and some of them get backlogs. In our senior batch, some of them are in disciplinary action. The highest package in the college is 31 LPA after taking the coaching in Bengaluru. Roles offered in the course are mainly the backend and frontend developer. Documentation is very important in jobs and the skills are mostly important.
content.Infrastructure: There is a Wi-Fi problem in the college and per head 1.5 GB is not enough for a student in the daytime. The quality of the food is good in the college rather compared to the other Lakireddy Bali Reddy College.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: RK College benches the rules and regulations of the students.

content.Placements: In our college, mostly the students are coming out with the documentation Java and DSA, these are the compulsory programs to learn the languages. overview_faqs.answer: The average BTech CSE salary for graduates in India can range between INR 4 LPA and INR 12 LPA. The scope of the BTech CSE programme in India is excellent and hence the starting salary packages offered by recruiters are also high as compared to some other engineering courses.The salary depends on factors like the years of experience you hold, your academic qualification, skill set, etc. Once you enter the industry and get some years of experience in hand, you will get a higher salary package. But, in the starting of your career journey, you can expect between INR 4 LPA and INR 6 LPA.

overview_faqs.question: What do Electrical Engineering professionals do?

faqs.answer: Shadan Women's College of Engineering and Technology has below criteria for taking admissions to it's various courses: CoursesEligibilityM.E./M.TechCandidate must have completed B.E./B.Tech. in ECE/AMIE in ECE, AMIE (Electronics and Telecommunication Engg)./AMIETE (Electronics & Telematics Engg.)/ Electronics or equivalent / Electronics from a UGC recognised University/ Institute. M.Sc. (Electronics) is not eligible to apply. Preference will be given to GATE qualified candidates over TS PGECET qualified candidates. Candidate must have secured 50% marks in group subjects taken together in the qualifying examination (45% for reserved category).B.E. / B.TechCandidates who have passed or appeared at the final year of the Diploma examination in Engineering conducted by the State Board of Technical Education and Training, Telangana / Andhra Pradesh or any other examination recognised as equivalent thereto by the State Board of Technical Education and Training, Telangana / Andhra Pradesh. Candidates should have completed 16 years of age, as on 31st December of the year of admission. There is no upper age limit.MBA/PGDMCandidate must have passed Bachelor Degree (BA / B.Com/ B.Sc/ BBA / BBM / BCA / BE / B.Tech / B. Pharmacy / Any 3 or 4 year Degree except Oriental Languages). Examinations of minimum three years duration with at least 50% marks (45% marks in case of reserved categories) in the qualifying examinations. Final year appearing students may also apply on provisional basis. The minimum age of the candidates should be 19 years as on the date of notification (Candidates whose date of Birth up to 30th MARCH, 2003). No maximum age limit.

review_summary.college_name: Shadan Women's College of Engineering and Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Review of Shadan Women's College of Engineering and Technology.

content.Placements: Placements don't happen much in our college. For the past few years, there have been less than none, but our faculty members help us in learning technologies for getting a job. They always guide us with resources that are very useful for us to apply for any job.
content.Infrastructure: We have very good facilities in our college like Wi-Fi and fully equipped laboratories. The library has every book that is needed for us during our course. We also have a canteen, which serves hygienic food at low cost. We have medical facilities like first aid too.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Positive environment and gives confidence to speak.

content.Placements: A few students were placed in from my course and the roles offered was of campus executive by the Intershala offering paid internship. We are also receiving mails from many companies regrading internship and online certified placement courses are offered to develop our skills.
content.Infrastructure: During my first year the infrastructure was bad their after covid, there were many improvements and canteen food is also good and in mess we can customize our food as per taste and the green area is created recently including the area for badminton basketball.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with faculty members, good facilities, and the quality of education.

content.Placements: We have a placement cell in our college. From our faculty members, we get the best advice for placements and internships. Many of our seniors got placed at different companies and they are now in good positions. As for our request, internship updates are also given to us.
content.Infrastructure: Everything in our college is good. There are neat and well-maintained canteens, a library, big classrooms, labs, etc. The washrooms are not good. Classrooms are huge, ventilated, and sufficient. Fans are also there, and the benches are also good. Huge labs are separately located on different floors. The labs include computer and electrical engineering labs, a physics lab, a chemistry lab, and a civil workshop lab.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied depending on that what they provide, this college is a good choice.

content.Placements: Around 65% of students got placed in our course, and the highest salary package offered in our college is ECE and the average is for IT, and the lowest is for CSE. The top recruiting companies for our course will be Infosys, Accenture, Google, Amazon, etc. Very less hand full students got internships right now. The top roles offered in my course are testing engineer, software engineer, data analytic, web developer, and more.
content.Infrastructure: Here in Shadan we have labs, but there are a few systems that don't work causing a problem for students. The classroom and infrastructure are overall good. We have a canteen, the food is tasty, and sports are scheduled for first-year students only.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: There are no placements in this college and also the infrastructure is poor.

content.Placements: There are no placements in this college. So students have to work hard to find a job or an internship. But there are lecturers who are always ready to guide the students. There are limited number of courses offered. A few of our seniors were able to bag good roles in the working industry through their consistent efforts.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides spacious classrooms, a library, and various labs for different subjects. The labs are well-equipped but the computer labs are the worst. Being a computer science student, it's devastating to look at the labs. The Wi-Fi network is only for the lab and it cannot be accessed by students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Shadan Women's College of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: We have very good facilities in our college like Wi-Fi and fully equipped laboratories. The library has every book that is needed for us during our course. We also have a canteen, which serves hygienic food at low cost. We have medical facilities like first aid too.

reviews.review_heading: Positive environment and gives confidence to speak.
reviews.review_text: During my first year the infrastructure was bad their after covid, there were many improvements and canteen food is also good and in mess we can customize our food as per taste and the green area is created recently including the area for badminton basketball.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with faculty members, good facilities, and the quality of education.
reviews.review_text: Everything in our college is good. There are neat and well-maintained canteens, a library, big classrooms, labs, etc. The washrooms are not good. Classrooms are huge, ventilated, and sufficient. Fans are also there, and the benches are also good. Huge labs are separately located on different floors. The labs include computer and electrical engineering labs, a physics lab, a chemistry lab, and a civil workshop lab.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied depending on that what they provide, this college is a good choice.
reviews.review_text: Here in Shadan we have labs, but there are a few systems that don't work causing a problem for students. The classroom and infrastructure are overall good. We have a canteen, the food is tasty, and sports are scheduled for first-year students only.

reviews.review_heading: There are no placements in this college and also the infrastructure is poor.
reviews.review_text: The college provides spacious classrooms, a library, and various labs for different subjects. The labs are well-equipped but the computer labs are the worst. Being a computer science student, it's devastating to look at the labs. The Wi-Fi network is only for the lab and it cannot be accessed by students.

reviews.review_heading: I'm not satisfied as the college doesn't provide placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available but not for all, only for faculty members. In labs, only 50% of the computers work well. I don't live in the hostel, but I guess the hostels I know are good around me. We've a canteen, and the food here is tasty. We have almost everything, like icecreams, juices, fast food etc.

reviews.review_heading: It's an average college. Not so good .
reviews.review_text: The canteen food is good and hygienic. The classrooms are average. They should improve the toilets they are too unhygienic. The computer lab software isn't up to date. But the electrical lab has all the necessary equipments. The library has all the books required for our course available.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissapointed by the end of final year.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. We have good benches and spacious classrooms. The washrooms need to be maintained. We have a good collection of books in the library. The canteen does provide varieties of food like breakfasts and snacks, fresh juices and fresh fruits.

reviews.review_heading: The good and the bad aspects of Shadan.
reviews.review_text: The college is totally equipped with great Wi-Fi and infrastructure. This makes the campus easily accessible for all the students. The canteen is clean and hygienic providing good food for the students. The labs are great and the students are encouraged to take time in solving their queries.

reviews.review_heading: It has good teachers but lacks in infrastructure and overall development of students' skills.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is not much good. The campus just has one 10-storeyed building and a canteen in front of it. There is no playground. However, labs, classrooms and libraries are well structured and are in good condition. Medical facilities are not provided, and sports and games are also not provided.

faqs.answer: No, you cannot become a lawyer without a Law degree.You mandatorily need to obtain degrees such as BA/BCom/BSc/BBA LLB or LLB in order to be a lawyer in India. content.Infrastructure: Our classrooms were well furnished with projectors. The laboratory was also well-equipped. The library was available, and several academic and non-academic books were provided. The bus facility was good.
content.Faculty: Our faculty members were very friendly and dedicated. They also provided notes to students. Our course curriculum was well designed, and it makes students industry-ready. Semester exams were moderate, and the pass percentage was 50%.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied, supporting placement every year, really good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: Every year college provides placement to several companies. College doesn't charge any fees for placement. They will help to perform well in interviews and other activities. College also help to get into internship while taking the course. 100% students will have to attend 2 internship within the course period.
content.Infrastructure: College has a well-equipped library with Ai settings, Wi-Fi. All labs in our college are superlative and well furnished. Campus has sports centre, gym, Auditorium, parking area, canteen etc. Quality of food in Canteen is outstanding, provide tasty food for affordable rate.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Best college in Kerala state.

content.Placements: Many students in my college have been given jobs through placements. Every year, many companies come to the college for interviews, and many students get jobs. Since the results are very high in the coming years, there is a possibility of getting many more placements.
content.Infrastructure: Our department has different teachers for each subject. Compared to all the polytechnics in Kerala, our department has the highest result percentage. Then I can't help but mention our library because it is a fully automatic library. Everything is automatic, from taking books, logging in, and returning books. We have all the books we need to study, as well as books for all competitive exams like B.Tech and PSC.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Architecture - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: You can join this college for studying.

content.Placements: Many students were placed. The management fee was high, but the merit fee was normal. Some companies provided jobs. About 20% of students got internships at different firms. Skills were important in this course. This was a good course.
content.Infrastructure: Labs, classrooms, and workshops were good. A canteen was available on campus. The library was famous and advanced. They served good food in the canteen. The ambiance of the college was good. There was fog in the morning. Good facilities were provided.

review_summary.college_name: National Academy of Event Management and Development, Ahmedabad Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Event Management - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Best institute if you are really interested in event line. Good internship and placement.

content.Infrastructure: Every classroom has air conditioning. Every classroom should have a led screen for fun and better interaction. The institute has a pleasant atmosphere. There are indoor games available. Those who want to read books can use the library. There is a theatre room for presentations and movies. Wi-Fi is available for an unbreakable connection during studies.
content.Faculty: All of the instructors are highly qualified and knowledgeable. Classes are interactive, with highly qualified teachers and a focus on having fun while learning. There is interaction and learning with top event managers. Teachers are helpful and friendly. You can score easily if you work hard. Models and project work are helpful for passing. The passing percentage is 50%.

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Event Management - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Review of National Academy of Event Management and Development, Ahmedabad.

content.Placements: All students get placements in top companies, and the top roles offered are marketing of events, artist management, and project management. In the first year, only a few students get internships, but in the second year, all students are placed as interns in different companies.
content.Infrastructure: This institute is well-equipped with all the modern facilities with Wi-Fi, auditorium, counseling room, game room, etc. PG is good but sometimes the food is not up to the point. I would recommend going for a good PG other than college-recommended ones.

individual_reviews.course: - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: I am absolutely dissatisfied with placements and teaching quality.

content.Placements: Our college was not that good in terms of academics and placements. Only 60% of the students were placed and also with the lowest salary packages. The highest salary package offered is 5 LPA and the lowest salary package offered is 2 LPA. Wizcraft and Percept D Mark were the top recruiters. Almost 95% of the students got an opportunity to do an internship.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college was very poor, and there was a small building in which there were a reception, 2 classrooms and a kitchen. There was no library in the college, and hostel facility was also not provided. Students had to manage their stay in PGs. The food quality was poor.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Event Management and PR (PGDEM) - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: It is a nice place to learn and explore.

content.Placements: This institute provides average placement opportunities. All students who are brilliant and score well in academics are placed while those students who are average or below average are not placed. Eventually, they have to find employment by themselves. Some good event companies like Coconut Event visit the campus for placements.
content.Infrastructure: This institute is in one commercial complex. Hence can't provide playground and field for various sports activity. The inner infrastructure is really nice as it has spacious classrooms for lectures. It has a good conference hall for conference purposes. There is a wealthy library.

individual_reviews.course: - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: This is the best place to learn.

content.Placements: Our college provides the best placement experience under the guidance of a well-known event management company with a number of certificates, that may give you the best job.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides the best facilities for the education. We have suitable space and professional classrooms. We have the best faculty who make you understand the subject. We have smart classrooms with AC, meeting room, a library in the college.
content.Faculty: The faculty members are superb with their professional and friendly behaviour. They always guide you to the best way for your success. The guest faculty across India come to our college with their personal experience and share it with us.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in English - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: If you want a good college in Patna, it is the best college.

content.Placements: Average students are placed at percentage above 70. I don't know about the highest, lowest, or average package offered in the course. I was doing B.A. in English.
content.Infrastructure: The whole campus has full Wi-Fi, and all departments have their own Wi-Fi. There are so many classes and labs for different departments. There is no hostel facility. It has a canteen which has good quality food. College has the good facilities for medical, sports, and games.
content.Faculty: Teachers are so helpful and always ready to help everyone. They are qualified and hold a Ph.D. degree so they are knowledgeable. They teach in a proper way so that students easily understand the whole subject. Semester exams are not so hard. For my course, teachers are so helpful that they told us to do M.A, and they will help us in completing the course.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Fully satisfied with the faculty, very good infrastructure, food, and students, changed my life.

content.Placements: The college provides good placement, and most students get average placement here. Companies coming here are not so big. They offer jobs with a decent salary. Initially, it is quite good and easy. I will recommend you all to take admission in this college.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides good. They have very good accommodation facilities, their hostel are quite good, and they also have labs and a library to provide a better learning experience. They also have good food, medical facilities, and sports. They are awesome.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Chemistry - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the faculty members, placements, and really good infrastructure.

content.Placements: I have done chemistry honors from this college and they provide placement in companies like Bajaj, TCS, etc. I don't know the exact number of students placed but 60% we can say. They offered 5 to 6 lacs per annum for my course but higher for technical courses.
content.Infrastructure: Recently, a fully furnished library has been provided for students. There is a canteen. Classrooms are also upgraded. Availability of most of the facilities. The infrastructure is great and medical facilities are also provided. There is a ground for sports.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Physics - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and environment with lack of placement opportunities.

content.Placements: My course was Physics honors. There was a batch of 200 students with 150 boys and 50 girls. My college was a government college. There were very rare placements and internship opportunities. Barely 5% of students got placements from different companies like TCS and HUL.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the college was huge as it was spread over a huge area. There was a large campus with a canteen where we chill out. There was a large playground where we used to play soccer and cricket. There was a basketball court also. Labs were also fine with a variety range of equipment, and classrooms were huge.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in Geography - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with this college because of faculty and good placement.

content.Placements: I am still studying. But I heard about this college. This college has good placements. The average package of this college is 5 Lacs per annum. The highest package from this college was 12 Lacs per annum. About 80 percent of students get placements every year.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms of this college are big. There is a library which is big and well-maintained, and almost every type of book is available here. The college provides free Wi-Fi connection for the students. A canteen is also available in this college. The college gives great importance to games and sports.

review_summary.college_name: TimesPro - Bennett University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Bennett is a pretty good college in terms of faculty.

content.Placements: Last year, placements were good. Since this college is new and had a lot of admissions this year, it might affect the placements of students. As Bennett is a new college, top companies like Amazon and Flipkart are not available for campus placements right now. However, since it is associated with the Times Group, many top-rated companies visit for campus placements. This year 2025, it received an A+ rank from NAAC.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel food is pretty good and serves actual meals. The mess has different counters for soft diets and spicy food. During fasting seasons like Navaratri, they also provide fasting meals. Wi-Fi facility is available all over the campus. The library lacks a bit of seating space, but there is a place called LRC where students can take their books and study. In the hostel, rooms are cleaned three times a week, but students have to call the cleaning staff themselves.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The reality of Bennett University.

content.Placements: Our university provides campus placements which a student can apply from 3rd year. Almost 90% of students got placed in my course. Top recruiting companies are Tata Power, Commvault, Xebia, TFT, NASSCOM, etc. The highest salary package offered in the course is 1.2 CPA. The average salary package offered is 11 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is 6 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure in my university for my course are very good. There is good Wi-Fi. We have regular labs and 4 libraries. They have an abundance of books and journals. The hostel the university offers is in triple sharing, which is not good for three students. In facilities, they provide average mess food, regular room service, and good drinking water.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Our college does not provide good placements but has good and modern infrastructure.

content.Placements: The highest salary package offered is 60 LPA. It varies all the time. The average salary package offered is around 6 LPA - 7 LPA. Around 30% of students got internships because of their skills and past work experience. Top companies are not coming from 2 years. Average companies like Capgemini and TCS visit our college.
content.Infrastructure: All things are available in our college for studying different types of things. Wi-Fi is below average because of the crowd all the time. Labs and classrooms are average. The food is below average. Sports are the things where students can play because our college is good in terms of other colleges.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Review of TimesPro - Bennett University.

content.Placements: There are many students in the entire place. Almost 60% of the students this year got placed in many companies. The highest salary package offered was 1.2 crores and the average salary package offered was around 8 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Microsoft and many other MNCs.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities given by the college are good and the Wi-Fi has good speed. Labs are well maintained and classrooms have air-conditioners. The hostels have good facilities. Bathrooms are cleaned every 2 days. We have many other facilities like helpless wage, and we can call anytime for any help. Our college has many sports facilities and we have cricket grounds, football ground, basketball and many others like swimming, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Bennett University review with honesty.

content.Placements: Many companies, including Microsoft and others, come to our college with good placement offers. This year, nearly 200 companies came to our college, and about 60% of the students were placed.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure provided by our college is good. The classrooms are good and well maintained. The Wi-Fi provides good speed. The food in the mess is average. The facilities in the hostel are good, and the bathrooms are cleaned every two days. The university has many sports facilities.
content.Faculty: The teachers are very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Their teaching is very helpful. The semester exams are a bit difficult, and you have to maintain a CGPA of 8 to maintain your scholarship. The university hosts many hackathon events to prepare students for their careers.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Environment is very nice and challenging, and students love it.

content.Placements: Good placement and internship opportunities are available for the students of the university. There is a new collaboration with companies and firms, which is good. All of it is very industry-friendly in terms of students. The GIFT City also offers many job opportunities. It also offers an excellent job market and a great chance for the future.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is top-notch and very modern, with all amenities for students and staff. The canteen has been the most welcoming place. Classrooms and facilities were very nice to see and have a great atmosphere for studying. All the classrooms are equipped with the best and most comfortable rooms and are the most accessible spaces.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The infrastructure is very good. Faculty members are absolutely supportive of students.

content.Placements: Placements are good, but not that many for bachelors. But master's or PhD students get good exposure to the work field. Otherwise, there is less chance of good placement from college. The best way is to skill ourselves and find jobs and internships.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is very good, and it is surrounded by nature. Wi-Fi is available. The library is of world-class level, and all important books, according to the course, are available. For labs, we have a whole separate building.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Great for career prospects, but faculty engagement is lacking.

content.Placements: IAR had a good placement for students. It gives opportunities to students for many internships in INTAS, AMUL, TCS, IFFCO, and more companies. The highest package is Rs. 180,000 and the average package is Rs. 45,000. Approximately 92-95% ratio of students were placed in Computer Engineering.
content.Infrastructure: IAR has brilliant facilities for libraries and sports. We really enjoy our campus life here. Every classroom has A.C. and a projector to make our studies better. The projector makes our studies easier. The hostel is nice, but we don’t have any medical facilities in our college. Anyway, teachers provide medicine for us when any student feels unwell.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Life at IAR in Gandhinagar, Gujarat.

content.Placements: Students with good CGPA who maintain above 8 are eligible for placements. The highest salary package offered at our college is 6 LPA. The average salary package offered is between 3-4 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Macleods, Zydus, Torrent Pharma, TCS, and Veloxcore. Most students secure internships in their final year. Students can also secure internships by their own during their 2nd and 3rd years. Top roles offered are Biopharmacist, Researcher, and Biotech Engineer.
content.Infrastructure: There are 18 labs in total for Biotechnology students. Labs are equipped with all the instruments required for practice and research work. Classrooms are spacious and it can inhabitat almost 120 students. Wi-Fi is also available for students in labs and the library. Most of the students spend their time studying in library. There are all kinds of materials required for study and research purpose. Library is built well which gives good environment to study. Hostel is not spacious but food and facilities are good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science in collaboration with IBM - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: This college is good and better than other colleges.

content.Placements: My college is great for research centers. My course name is BSc AI and Data Science Hons, and it is a new course in our college, so I have more opportunities for my future. I am confident about my job, as I have heard good things from seniors. I have good career opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: My college has good library and knowledgeable librarian with a lot of books. Library provides Wi-Fi, desktops, and computers. Canteen serves good food, including some fast food. We have big grounds to play games, and we also have medical support.
